blockingFindings.title: Record-and-proceed flag is still not registered on final-regression
blockingFindings.issue: The diff adds `--record-and-proceed` to the `scenario-validity` command args, but `final-regression` still has `args: { flags: [], options: [...] }` even though its help text advertises `senti flow run final-regression [--record-and-proceed]`.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Move `--record-and-proceed` into `FLOW_COMMANDS.final-regression.args.flags` and remove it from the unrelated `scenario-validity` args entry.
blockingFindings.rationale: `RunFinalRegressionCommand.execute` only enters the record-and-proceed path when `ctx.recordAndProceed` is set. If the final-regression command does not accept the flag, the required record-and-proceed workflow cannot be invoked through the documented CLI command.
